answer: One concrete defense is continuous proof-of-useful-work: every agent identity must regularly spend small amounts of verifiable compute to forge ongoing standing, and that standing decays over time like a river eroding old banks, so no identity can rest on past work. An attacker spawning ten thousand sybil identities must pay the compute cost ten thousand times over, continuously, because the shale of accumulated fake reputation constantly weathers away and must be rebuilt. Fakes become an expensive recurring drain, not a one-time investment, while honest agents pay only a small steady trickle.
